verdict.rationale: Milvus documents its own metadata filtering in search requests, applied before ANN search, and Milvus Lite also lists metadata filtering among its features. The evidence never describes what filter expressions are supported, so the 'rich' part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documented range operators, geo filtering, nested boolean logic, array membership operators, and independent or hands-on corroboration of complex filters.

support.subject: As a developer, I can express rich filter conditions (ranges, geo, nested boolean logic, array membership) in queries

citations.quote: You can include filtering conditions in a search request so that Milvus conducts metadata filtering before conducting ANN searches
covers most of the features such as vector data persistence and management, vector CRUD operations, sparse and dense vector search, metadata filtering
